sights.w: A grassy clifftop park at the tip of Chinen Cape, about 40 m above the sea, with a roughly 250-degree view over the reef toward Kudaka and Komaka islands, a short walk from Sefa-utaki. It is one of the settings of the 2021 anime 'The Aquatope on White Sand', the reason the Anime Tourism Association named Nanjō one of its '88 Anime Pilgrimage' sites.
sights.anime: The Aquatope on White Sand (白い砂のアクアトープ, 2021) — cape park shown in the series; Nanjō is an Anime Tourism '88' site

sights.n: Okitsura pilgrimage — Gushikawa, Uruma (沖ツラ聖地 具志川公民館・具志川ビーチ)
sights.address: 381 Gushikawa, Uruma, Okinawa, Japan (Gushikawa Community Hall 具志川公民館)
sights.w: The residential Gushikawa district of Uruma is the main real-world setting of the anime 'Fall in Love with Okinawa Dialect' (沖ツラ). Gushikawa Beach appears in episode 2 and other walk-to-school scenes, and pilgrims start from the Gushikawa Community Hall, which hands out Uruma's official location map and has one of three Okitsura manhole covers (the others are at KIN Sunrise Beach and Michi-no-Eki Ginoza).
sights.anime: Fall in Love with Okinawa Dialect (沖縄で好きになった子が方言すぎてツラすぎる / 沖ツラ, 2025 anime) — set in Gushikawa, Uruma; official city location map and collab manhole
